verdict.rationale: E2B is exposed as an SDK/API and CLI (Sandbox.create(), files.read/write, commands.run, e2b CLI) that AI agents call programmatically; there is no evidence of a natural-language interface, chat-based control, or NL-to-command translation layer built into E2B itself. The HN comment about agents generating terminal commands describes third-party agent behavior built on top of E2B, not a native NL command capability of the product.
